newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IOC buys Labuan along with Qua Iboe,Suez in tender.
newsitem.headline: IOC buys Labuan along with Qua Iboe,Suez in tender.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has bought a Malaysian Labuan crude cargo along with three very large crude carriers of Nigeria's Qua Iboe and a cargo of Egypt's Suez Blend in its October tender, traders said on Monday.
They said the Labuan crude cargo was sold buy a Swiss oil trader at a premium of 80 cents per barrel to APPI quotes on a free-on-board basis.

Traders had said earlier the same Swiss trader had also sold two 2.0-million-barrel cargoes of Qua Iboe at dated Brent plus 0.8395 per barrel. The third 2.0-million-barrel cargo was sold by a US major oil firm at dated Brent plus $1.05 per barrel.
Traders said IOC also bought 900,000 barrels of Suez Blend at a two-cent-per-barrel premium to the EGPC quotes or official selling price.
